summary: OBOOK Holdings Inc. (OwlTing Group, NASDAQ: OWLS) filed a Form 6-K announcing a cross-border payment partnership with Credible Finance to open a China payment corridor. The network-to-network partnership involves OwlPay Harbor, which now serves over 50 enterprise clients. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change elements. The filing is a routine current report disclosing a business partnership and operational metrics, not a special situation.
